title: AI-Driven Predictive Beamforming for Climate-Resilient 5G/6G Networks
summary: Addis Ababa Science and Technology University proposes weather-aware beamforming, with simulation and toolkit development planned.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The research design combines weather prediction and reinforcement learning to adapt high-frequency communication links. Simulation, data development, and reproducible tools are planned. More reliable connections during adverse weather are intended benefits, without measured live-network results.
purpose: Adapt beamforming to weather-related signal degradation.
system: AI-Driven Predictive Beamforming for Climate-Resilient 5G/6G Networks

ratings.reason: Predictive beamforming is a research proposal with simulation and toolkit development still planned.
Reliable critical services during adverse weather are projected benefits.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 16: AI-Driven Predictive Beamforming for Climate-Resilient 5G/6G Networks

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: Predictive beamforming aims to maintain links in bad weather
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
